$comment: Policy for the acceptance-test CI. Records only decisions the code cannot express;
packages, tests, resource types and sweepers are discovered from the repository on
every run.
A package's product is its directory prefix (cloud_volume -> cloud). Each product
has one default group, and may have more groups that claim packages by prefix.
Every discovered package must land in exactly one group or be excluded.
Where a job runs. Credentials and the project come from the named GitHub
environment. Cloud targets name a region; account-level products (CDN, DNS,
FastEdge, Storage, WAAP) run once on the account target, not once per region.

lux.reason: Cloud default: supports Kubernetes and standard file shares

sines.reason: offers the virtual GPU flavors the GPU tests use

$comment: One CI job per group per run. go_test_p is go test -p (packages at once) and
go_test_parallel is -parallel (tests at once within a package). Cloud starts
conservatively because its tests share regional quotas. Split a product further
only when the test reports show a clear need.
GPU is a separate weekly group: it needs a different region and is the most
expensive part of the suite.
Packages kept out of every plan, with the reason the reports show. A package whose
resources no registered sweeper reclaims must be listed here, or the guards fail.
excluded_packages.cloud_gpu_baremetal_cluster: baremetal GPU hardware is not available to the test account

$comment: The pre-merge smoke set: one representative per product family, run with an
anchored regex. Go's -run is an unanchored match, so a loose pattern would also
pick up the slower import tests.
